command_description: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable with LogName, ProviderName, Id, StartTime and EndTime; -MaxEvents 100 -ErrorAction Stop. UTC DateTime objects supplied for both bounds.
interpretation: No matching Windows System power, sleep/resume, operating-system start/stop or clock-change event was found within the queried interval. The cause of the SSH connection reset remains unestablished.
limitations: An empty filtered event query does not prove uninterrupted wakefulness or network connectivity.
No application logs, personal application data, network traces or system settings were read or changed.
The tunnel stderr identifies a connection reset but contains no termination timestamp or causal attribution.
